svg.text: The agent drives the existing deterministic pipeline through tool calls — it reimplements no training logic

g.text: The agent loop knows no vendor's wire format (core/llm_client.py)
Every tool call is metered — hooked on complete_with_tools(), not just complete()
core/agent/tools.py · wraps existing capabilities, adds no new implementation
All training, evaluation and deployment logic — the agent only calls it, never rewrites or bypasses it
AST allowlist sandbox · subprocess wall-clock timeout · noise gate
The LLM never gets to declare success on its own

svg.text: ✕ No side-effecting tools such as submit_training
Findings return to the main agent as one tool_result
Automatic fallback when tool calling is unavailable
Function-calling reliability varies across small local models
Zero tool calls in a turn → deterministic state machine
The UI says so plainly; it does not fake thinking
Fallback is sticky, not re-probed every message
Capability is unaffected — only autonomy is
